title: GCC First Release email
lineage: A third-party reproduction of a purported 22 March 1987 email reports FTP source distribution, VAX and Sun machine descriptions, and FSF beta tape offered for $150 plus applicable tax or overseas air mail. Original archive not verified. The project timeline independently confirms date of beta release.
